sample_text: Xin chào. Đây là mẫu thử giọng tiếng Việt của Nolane Video Studio. Trời trở lạnh, trăng sáng trên những tán cây.

voices.name: Nolane VI — Warm Documentary Narrator
voices.description: An original fictional Vietnamese female narrator, adult, warm low-mid register, smooth resonant timbre, clear Hanoi-standard Vietnamese articulation, measured documentary pacing, calm and intimate emotional delivery, precise final consonants and natural sentence endings.

voices.name: Nolane VI — Credible Male Expert
voices.description: An original fictional Vietnamese male expert voice, adult, medium-low register, grounded chest resonance, clean Hanoi-standard Vietnamese pronunciation, steady measured cadence, restrained confidence, articulate technical terms and numbers, neutral documentary delivery without theatrical exaggeration.

voices.name: Nolane VI — Bright Channel Host
voices.description: An original fictional Vietnamese female host voice, young adult, medium register with a bright forward timbre, lively but controlled energy, natural conversational rhythm, crisp consonants, friendly curiosity, varied intonation and clear Northern Vietnamese diction.

voices.name: Nolane VI — Cinematic Storyteller
voices.description: An original fictional Vietnamese male storyteller, mature adult, low register, dark warm resonance, deliberate cinematic pacing, soft breath-supported phrases, nuanced dramatic emphasis, articulate Vietnamese tones and consonants, intimate rather than booming.

voices.name: Nolane VI — Gentle Companion
voices.description: An original fictional Vietnamese female companion voice, adult, medium-low register, soft rounded timbre, reassuring warmth, natural pauses, relaxed conversational rhythm, emotionally empathetic but not whispery, clear Vietnamese pronunciation.
